name: CATF_SWITCH_LATCHED
meaning: set by MSG_SWITCH_ON 0x1f (launches once), cleared by MSG_SWITCH_OFF 0x20

name: CATF_ARM_ALONG_Z
meaning: facing within 99 of 0x400/0xc00: the arm and throw run along z

name: CATF_THROW_NEGATIVE
meaning: facing in [0x39d,0x863]: the bucket sits on the negative side of the axis

name: CATF_ARM_AT_REST
meaning: set at Init/Reset/arm return, cleared when the throw starts

name: CATF_BUCKET_SOLID
meaning: arm at rest and bucket seen empty: CustomCollide makes the bucket box solid
